title: slixmpp-i386 → devel
diff:
diff --git a/ubuntu-release b/ubuntu-release
index 177fefb..4ca8277 100644
--- a/ubuntu-release
+++ b/ubuntu-release
@@ -105,3 +105,21 @@ force-badtest tree-sitter-powershell/0.25.10-3/i386
 force-badtest tree-sitter-verilog/1.0.3-4/i386
 force-badtest tree-sitter-yaml/0.7.2-3/i386
 force-badtest tree-sitter-vim/0.8.1-2/i386
+
+# slixmpp 1.17 adds an arch:any Rust extension not built on i386,
+# python3-slixmpp and its rdepends are no longer installable there
+force-badtest slixmpp/1.17.0-2/i386
+force-badtest prometheus-xmpp-alerts/0.5.3-1.3build1/i386
+
+# crane, the arch:any CLI built from go-containerregistry, is not built on
+# i386 so the test deps (crane:i386) are not installable
+force-badtest go-containerregistry/0.20.7+ds1-3/i386
+
+# python3-surfer depends on mayavi2, which cannot be built on armhf (it
+# build-depends on architecture-is-64-bit) nor on ppc64el (it needs
+# pyface/envisageonly built on amd64 arm64 armhf i386)
+force-badtest pysurfer/0.11.2-2/armhf
+force-badtest pysurfer/0.11.2-2/ppc64el
+
+# openfoam requires a 64-bit architecture (architecture-is-64-bit), never built on armhf
+force-badtest openfoam/1912.200626-4/armhf
